answer: Pool rewards by funding lineage. Every identity's first coins trace back to some funding address, and the chain groups all identities sharing an origin into one lineage whose combined payout grows only with the square root of its size. A plume of 100 accounts fed from one wallet earns about ten times one account, not a hundred. Routing funds through a karst of hidden hops does not help much, because each truly separate lineage must anchor fresh stake from outside the economy, a real cost per fake.
